|descr= Defines a music track played on activation. If another track is playing already, this will stop it and start the new track.

Track is a subclass name of CfgMusic. In addition, "$STOP$" (stops the current music track) or use <sqf inline>playMusic ""</sqf>.
When used in a trigger, the track starts on activation but does not automatically stop on deactivation.

|s1= trigger [[setMusicEffect]] track

|p1= trigger: [[Object]]

|p2= track: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= waypoint [[setMusicEffect]] track

|p21= waypoint: [[Waypoint]]

|p22= track: [[String]]

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_trigger setMusicEffect "Track1";</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>[_group1,1] setMusicEffect "$STOP$";</sqf>

|seealso= [[createTrigger]] [[setSoundEffect]] [[setTitleEffect]]
}}
